analytics.name: Analytic 1725
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect SSL Pinning by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Banking, financial, healthcare apps with documented legitimate SSL pinning AND IT security review approval. Include with business justification. Tightening: empty — all custom TLS trust flagged for review.
Default 3 consecutive inspection failures from same app to same destination. Single failure may be transient.

log_sources.name: android:EMM
log_sources.channel: Managed package inventory/status and package metadata

log_sources.channel: DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes custom TLS trust evaluation, OkHttp CertificatePinner, or custom-anchor TrustManager NOT IN $ApprovedPinningApps$ — custom pin validation is the evasion mechanism
